error_summary: The Hugging Face compressed-tensors runtime installed a first-forward hook that began decompressing the full 2.8T MXFP4 model. GPU 0 had 267.69 GiB total and 267.65 GiB in use; a further 42 MiB allocation failed after 5,645 of 247,296 quantized modules were decompressed.
blocker: The only official public moonshotai Kimi-K3 checkpoint is MXFP4 packed inference weights. The storage-oriented Transformers compressed-tensors path requires full decompression for forward execution, which cannot fit on B300:8; the vLLM packed inference kernels do not expose an autograd input-gradient path. No official full-size BF16 Kimi-K3 checkpoint was present in the moonshotai public Hub catalog, and FDR had no Kimi K3 BF16 Volume.
